name: tensorviz
description: Explore local PyTorch models with tensorViz.

interface.longDescription: A local TensorViz host for PyTorch architecture, tensor shapes and model changes. Downloads a verified compiled runtime automatically. This preview supports macOS Apple Silicon and CPython 3.12. VS Code and Node.js are not required.
defaultPrompt: Explain this PyTorch model and show its TensorViz graph.
